findings.detail: FEAT-001 verified: new additive migration supabase/migrations/20261101_orders_entitlements.sql widens the orders_plan_check to include 'single' and adds billing_type/period_start/credit_consumed with backfill and a (user_id,status) index; it does not edit the existing 20261021 migration or schema.sql, and carries the 'run in Supabase SQL editor' comment.

Server-side purchase verification is correct and fail-closed: success page fetches the Stripe session, requires payment_status==='paid'||status==='complete' AND metadata.user_id===current user, and UPSERTs via the service-role client with onConflict 'stripe_session_id' (idempotent on refresh). Every failure path (missing STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, missing admin client, unpaid, user mismatch, fetch/parse error) returns without granting and renders a graceful summary. Does not crash without session_id.

Allowance enforced in launchCampaign: getEntitlement(user.id) runs after auth and before the campaigns insert; !canCreate throws the exact required message and inserts nothing; consumeAllowance runs only after a successful insert and before redirect. getEntitlement/consumeAllowance degrade to a NO_PLAN (canCreate:false) result when the service-role client is unavailable, so behavior is fail-closed rather than crashing. admin.ts now returns null when URL/service-role key are missing, and both existing callers (users/actions.ts, users/page.tsx) guard the null.

FEAT-002 is display-only: all renames change visible text only. No href, resource-library kind= prop (audience/template preserved) or object keys, server-action name, form field name (title/templateId/groupId/landingPageUrl), DB column, or {{link}} token was changed. Checkout route request shape (metadata[user_id]/metadata[plan]) is untouched. Removed-string grep is clean; the two residual hits are the documented expected exceptions (a CSS comment and the intentional new 'Plans & billing' h1).

FEAT-003 topbar redesign preserves all behavior: mobile-menu toggle, notifications dropdown, ThemeToggle, role-pill, and greeting all remain wired (only markup change is adding className='topbar-heading' to the existing title wrapper). Styling stays semantic-class CSS (no Tailwind conversion), both light and .dark topbar/role-pill/icon variants defined, and the 760px (hides kicker/role-pill, shows mobile-menu) and 540px (shrinks title) media rules still target topbar elements. No edits to landing/template studio structure or iframe sandbox attributes.

summary: All three features satisfy the task. FEAT-001: Stripe payments are verified server-side, orders are idempotently UPSERTed via the service-role client, the new additive migration exists (no existing migration edited), and per-plan allowance is enforced in launchCampaign (fail-closed when service role is absent) with consumption after a successful insert. FEAT-002: terminology changes are display-only with no route/action/form-field/prop/key/{{link}} changes and the checkout shape intact. FEAT-003: topbar redesign preserves every handler/element, keeps semantic-class CSS with light+dark+responsive coverage, and leaves builder/studio iframes untouched. npm run lint exits 0 and npm run build succeeds.
